_comment: Layer-Shift config - the ONLY place chain/backend wiring lives. Addresses below were VERIFIED ON-CHAIN 2026-07-19 (bytecode + symbol()) before entry per DEFI_REVIEW.md: SMOKE on Base, DIAMONDS + GOLD on Ethereum mainnet. backend_base_url stays empty until scripts/deploy-backend.sh runs (Cloudflare token needs account access).

icp._note: Layer 4. Canister IDs stay EMPTY until deployed (docs/architecture/adr-icp-integration.md). Empty = IcpBackend is inert and reads fall back to backend_base_url, so shipping these keys early changes nothing at runtime. For a LOCAL replica set scheme=http, gateway=localhost, port=4943.

contract_chains._note: Cross-chain: wallet-provider eth_call only sees the wallet's current chain, so balance checks go through the backend /balances endpoint (stateless, read-only).

analytics._comment: PostHog product analytics. `token` is a PostHog PROJECT WRITE key (phc_...) which is public by design — it can only append events, never read them. It still lives here rather than in code, per the project rule that no keys are hardcoded. Empty token = analytics fully disabled (no network, no JS loaded). CI injects the real value from the POSTHOG_TOKEN repo secret.
